question: If at 8:45 am, the minute hand of a clock is pointing towards the north, then in which direction will it point at 9:00 pm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d8975830390f3c3f708c79542acad92124386cf6266797eae1417adfbc0d4b1.png] 

If at 8:45 am, the minute hand of a clock is pointing towards the north,

Thus, it clearly means that it point 90º Anti-clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a2fab04cf82edecf0ca892b7f1a50fac0546da6f6bf25df8595e637e22df2ab.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc46c9d6efa2d6842d0a0c7231a82bb6904050bf386ba34078ec3f276fa64768.png] 

After, 15 minutes will it point at 9:00 pm by moving 90º clockwise direction that is east.

Moving in the 90º in clockwise direction, direction's will be

**→ North → East**

→ East → South

→ South → West

→ West → North.

 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e04969080dbd0273bfdc7564870947d6618ffbcb02b347f29b506f7bf8d19f0f.png] 

Thus, at the time of 9 PM. minute hand will be in the direction of East.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
